# ferentin_mcp_routes (Data Source)

List every MCP route in the tenant, sorted by name. Includes the routes the platform's endpoint MCP rule conversion made from `steer` rules.

Every item carries `import_id`, the ID its resource's `import` block takes, and `managed_by`, who created it (`console`, `iac`, …). Filter on `managed_by = "console"` to find what Terraform does not manage yet.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every MCP route in the tenant, by name.
data "ferentin_mcp_routes" "all" {}

# Where each remote route sends its server.
output "remote_routes" {
  value = { for r in data.ferentin_mcp_routes.all.routes : r.name => r.steer_to_url if r.mechanism == "rewrite_to_gateway" }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `tenant_id` (String) Tenant to list. Defaults to the provider's.

### Read-Only

- `routes` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--routes))

<a id="nestedatt--routes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `routes`

Read-Only:

- `device_group_ids` (List of String) Device groups the route is narrowed to. Empty: every device.
- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `import_id` (String) `<tenant_id>/<route_id>`, for an `import` block.
- `last_modified_by` (String) Who wrote it last. Divergence from `managed_by` means it changed hands.
- `managed_by` (String) Who created it: `console`, `iac`, `cli`, `system` or `unknown`. Never changes.
- `mechanism` (String) `shim_wrap` (local) or `rewrite_to_gateway` (remote).
- `name` (String)
- `route_id` (String)
- `steer_to_url` (String) The gateway route a remote route rewrites to. Null: the scope's own gateway.
- `target_kind` (String) `host`, `url_prefix`, `package` or `argv_contains`.
- `target_values` (List of String) The target's values as the platform stores them.
